title: Keep reusable guidance with one documentation owner
scope: Changes to root or nested AGENTS.md files and docs/engineering Markdown that add, copy, or relocate reusable engineering guidance.
applies_when: A changed scoped instruction file states guidance that also applies outside its subtree or responsibility, or restates guidance already owned by another canonical document.
violation: The change creates a second normative owner by copying or paraphrasing reusable rules instead of keeping them with the canonical engineering or implementation owner and routing to that owner.
non_violation: A concise routing reference, a genuinely subtree-local constraint, or an implementation-local invariant is not duplication merely because it names a shared rule or owner.
evidence: Cite the changed guidance, the existing canonical location, and the scopes showing that both texts claim ownership of the same reusable requirement.
